Oracle Cloud Integration Engineer - Remote

Bright Vision Technologies is a technology consulting and software development company delivering cloud, AI, data, and enterprise solutions across the United States.
This is a fantastic opportunity to join an established and well-respected organization offering tremendous career growth potential.

Job Title: Oracle Cloud Integration Engineer
Location: 100% Remote (U.S.)
Position Type: Full-time, Direct W2
Salary Range: $100,000–$150,000 Annually
Experience Required: 6+ years

Sponsorship: U.S. Citizens, Green Card Holders, EAD Holders, and H-1B transfer candidates are encouraged to apply. We are unable to sponsor new H-1B visa petitions for this position.

Job Summary
We are seeking an experienced Oracle Integration Cloud (OIC) Developer to design, build, and operate enterprise integration scenarios that connect Oracle Cloud Applications, on-premises Oracle systems, and third-party platforms. In this role you will own the full integration lifecycle, from analysis and design through development, testing, deployment, monitoring, and ongoing support. The ideal candidate will bring strong hands-on experience with OIC integrations, processes, and visual builder applications, and will combine that with a clear understanding of integration patterns, API management, and Oracle Cloud Applications data models.

Key Responsibilities
Design and develop integration flows in Oracle Integration Cloud (OIC) connecting Oracle Cloud Applications (ERP, HCM, CX) with on-premises and third-party systems.
Build app-driven and scheduled orchestrations, including complex mappings, error handling, and recovery flows.
Configure and operate a wide range of OIC adapters (REST, SOAP, FTP, Salesforce, Workday, ServiceNow, custom).
Develop process automation flows using OIC Process Cloud Service for human-centric workflows.
Build Visual Builder Cloud Service (VBCS) applications integrated with OIC and Oracle Cloud Applications.
Implement API management strategies, including security policies, throttling, and developer portals.
Design robust error-handling and notification patterns, including retries, escalation, and resubmission workflows.
Optimize performance of high-volume integrations through batching, parallelism, and asynchronous patterns.
Migrate legacy Oracle SOA Suite or third-party integrations to OIC.
Collaborate with Oracle Cloud Applications functional teams to align integrations with business processes.
Provide hypercare and post-go-live support, including incident response and root-cause analysis.
Maintain comprehensive, current technical documentation — including architecture diagrams, design decisions, configuration references, runbooks, and operational procedures — so that the system remains supportable, auditable, and easy to onboard new engineers onto over time.
Mentor junior developers and contribute to internal integration patterns and standards.
Required Qualifications
Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical discipline.
Five or more years of integration experience, with strong hands-on time in Oracle Integration Cloud.
Solid experience with Oracle Cloud Applications (ERP, HCM, or CX) data models and APIs.
Experience with REST and SOAP web service development.
Working knowledge of Visual Builder Cloud Service (VBCS) and Process Cloud Service.
Familiarity with API management concepts and Oracle API Platform.
Strong scripting skills (Groovy, JavaScript) and SQL.
Experience with security standards (OAuth2, SAML, mTLS).
Excellent troubleshooting, communication, and documentation skills.
Prior experience migrating from Oracle SOA Suite to OIC is a strong plus.
Preferred Qualifications
Oracle Cloud Platform Application Integration certification.
Experience with Oracle Autonomous Database integration.
Familiarity with event-driven integration on OCI.
Exposure to DevOps and CI/CD patterns for OIC content.
Working knowledge of related platforms (MuleSoft, Boomi, SAP CPI).
How to Apply
Would you like to know more about this opportunity? For immediate consideration, please send your resume to Jenny@bvteck.com or contact us at (908) 505-3544. Learn more about Bright Vision Technologies at www.bvteck.com.
